stem.x: Which of the following is the appropriate description of constructors in Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)?

b.x: Constructors are invoked only after an object has been fully instantiated.
In class-based OOP, constructors do not play any role in object creation or initialization.
Constructors are responsible for initializing objects in class-based OOP.
Constructors are inherited by subclasses exactly like regular methods in all class-based OOP languages.
